guard_denials_note: all 4 were path-matching false positives (`..`, `//`, `/` tokens); 38 allowed spec-writer touches
deviations: Ellers: no int8 OverflowError on KNOWN_BUGS inputs (e.g. 12x17 xskew=0.9); returns a valid perfect maze
Collision: no TypeError on mazes with loops/rooms (KNOWN_BUGS); returns valid shortest paths
ShortestPath: always returns a shortest path when one exists (original sometimes returns none)
ShortestPaths: returns equal-length shortest paths only, capped at 32
RNG consumption by algorithms is the port's own design: same seed yields different (valid) mazes than the original
HuntAndKill/DungeonRooms: random hunt falls back to a full scan so every cell is always visited
DungeonRooms: rooms touching the outer frame are skipped (Q2)
Grid stored as Uint8Array instead of NumPy int8
